selected_evidence.requirement: Web service is active on TCP 8081 through loopback
selected_evidence.summary: The enabled service listens exactly on 127.0.0.1:8081 and returns HTTP 200 with the expected content.

selected_evidence.requirement: Web service is not reachable through external interfaces
selected_evidence.summary: Direct requests to node1's external address 10.100.88.10:8081 failed with connection refused before and after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55; the native reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 23b04638-32ba-464b-9167-44c52895a88d; system state, service, listener, content checksum, loopback response, and external denial all recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- listener ---'
ss -ltnp | awk 'NR == 1 || $4 ~ /:8081$/'
printf '%s\n' '--- loopback request ---'
loop_code=$(curl --noproxy '*' --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 3 --output /tmp/loopback-web-body --write-out '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/)
printf 'http_code=%s\n' "$loop_code"
grep -o 'Loopback-only web service' /tmp/loopback-web-body
printf '%s\n' '--- external-interface request (failure required) ---'
set +e
external_output=$(curl --noproxy '*' --silent --show-error --max-time 3 --output /tmp/loopback-web-external-body --write-out 'http_code=%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8081/" 2>&1)
external_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'target=%s:8081 curl_exit=%s %s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$external_rc" "$external_output"
test "$external_rc" -ne 0
test "$loop_code" = 200
